name: Riddhi Corporate Services Limited
about: Riddhi Corporate Services Limited provides document management, inbound and outbound contact center, data entry, software development, logistics, transportation, verification, and recruitment services in India. It provides procurement services comprising supplier, purchase order, and compliance and risk management; human resources management services, including recruitment, onboarding, and payroll services, as well as employee self-services portal; back office service comprising data entry and document management; verification services, such as address and android based verification services; logistics services, which includes last mile delivery and third party logistics services; warehousing services; and call center services, such as inbound, outbound call center, and quality assurance services. The company also provides various services, such as document digitalization, airport ancillary, field, and web and data enabled services. In addition, it offers various products, which includes employee remote process, human resource management system, asset lifecycle management, data entry system, information technology, and software developments to corporate clients. Riddhi Corporate Services Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
